caption: The drawing depicts a scene set outdoors with a large tree with yellow and green leaves on the left and a willow tree with long, drooping branches on the right. In the foreground, four female figures dressed in long, white or pale colored gowns are gathered around a large stone monument or urn on a pedestal, with one figure placing a floral wreath on the urn. A young child stands beside the figure on the right. The monument sits on green grass, and the ground is filled with curved, hatched lines in green, brown, and yellow colors representing grassy terrain. In the background, there is a white picket fence that curves up a hill and an arched white church building with a tall steeple surrounded by yellow and green trees. Birds are visible in the middle background, flying near the fenced area. In the lower left corner, there is a gray rectangular tablet or plaque bearing an inscription with multiple lines of text. The sky is a light gray with subtle shading. The colors in the drawing are primarily muted greens, yellows, browns, grays, and whites, with additional blue, pink, and red accents on the floral wreath and some clothing details.
title: Mourning Embroidery
